title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-04-14
content:
Release Engineering - Weekly Meeting Notes
Date: 2026-04-14
Attendees: Alex Kim, Priya Shah, Miguel Torres, Sophie Nguyen, Jon Park, Lina Gomez (SRE)
Absentees: None

Agenda:
- Review current release train status (stable, next cut, canary)
- Hotfix queue and prioritization
- Changelog highlights for this week
- Blockers and rollback readiness
- Action items and owners

Summary:
1) Release train status
- Stable branch: 2026-04-stable currently serving production; no incidents in last 7 days. Throughput and latency within SLOs after kernel bump.
- Next cut: Targeting 2026-04-21 for train cut. Candidate tag: v2026.04.21-rc1.
- Canary: Canary rollout of runtime 1.9.3 progressing (canary at 10% traffic). Observability looks good; two minor increase in 95th p90 for long-context tests but within tolerance.
- Dependency note: New cuDNN build on dedicated infra scheduled 2026-04-17; baseline perf tests scheduled 04/16.

2) Hotfixes
- Hotfix queue contains 3 items prioritized as P1, P2, P3.
  - P1: ENGREL-1234 - memory leak in kv-cache pruning on long requests. Hotfix branch hotfix/kv-cache-leak ready, tests green in staging. Plan: rollback gating disabled for canary, apply hotfix to canary on 04/14 evening, if stable after 2h promote to stable. Owner: Priya Shah.
  - P2: ENGREL-1241 - mkldnn fallback path causing lower throughput on some Dedicated customers. Mitigation: config toggle for kernel selection; patch in review PR#567. Owner: Miguel Torres.
  - P3: ENGREL-1248 - changelog formatting issue in release notes generation (non-blocking). Will merge to next train. Owner: Sophie Nguyen.

3) Changelog highlights for upcoming cut
- Major: improved attention kernel selection that reduces latency for long sequences by ~12%. (PR#553)
- Fixes: kv-cache leak hotfix, improved autoscaler backpressure handling, various doc fixes.
- Deprecations: legacy batching API flag marked deprecated; migration guide added to Confluence.

4) Blockers and Risks
- Blocker: Load test revealed a regression in autoscaler under synthetic spike test ENGREL-1250. Root cause under investigation (possible race in group resize). Mitigation: temporarily increase min replicas for Dedicated clusters on critical customers. Owner: Jon Park.
- Risk: cuDNN update may shift performance curves; we need baseline numbers before full rollout. If baseline shows >5% regression on 95th latency, we will hold train. Action: Lina to run perf suite on 04/16 and report.

5) Rollback readiness
- Canary is configured with automatic fallback to previous image; rollback playbook reviewed last week and is up-to-date. All on-call SREs notified of potential hotfix window 04/14-04/15.

6) Action items
- Priya Shah: Apply hotfix/kv-cache-leak to canary 2026-04-14 20:00 UTC and monitor for 2 hours. Update ENGREL-1234 with results. Due: 2026-04-14.
- Miguel Torres: Address PR#567 comments and coordinate toggle rollout for mkldnn fallback. Due: 2026-04-16.
- Lina Gomez: Run cuDNN perf baseline suite on dedicated infra and upload results to Confluence. Due: 2026-04-16.
- Jon Park: Investigate autoscaler group resize race (ENGREL-1250) and propose temporary config change for min replicas. Due: 2026-04-15.
- Sophie Nguyen: Merge changelog formatting fix into next train and validate generated notes. Due: 2026-04-17.

Notes / Misc:
- Reminder: cut checklist updated in Confluence (link in linked artifacts). Please confirm your checklist items 48 hours before cut.
- Customer update: We notified two Dedicated customers of potential short maintenance window for kernel update; CS drafted message awaiting legal review.

Next meeting: 2026-04-21 10:00 UTC (pre-cut coordination).

Quick standup fragments captured during meeting (working-doc style):
- "Priya: canary hotfix ready, need one more thumbs up from QA"
- "Miguel: toggle will require small config migration for a subset of customers; will document rollout plan"
- "Jon: saw 2x spike in replica churn during synthetic test, investigating"
- "Lina: perf suite ETA Friday morning, will attach logs"

End of notes.
